scripts.dev: npm run dev:backend & npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:speech
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix Backend && npm run build --prefix Frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.ci:frontend: npm run lint --prefix Frontend && npx prettier --check Frontend && npm run build --prefix Frontend && npm run test --prefix Frontend -- --run
scripts.ci:backend: npm run build --prefix Backend && npm run test:unit --prefix Backend
scripts.ci:quality: npm run lint && npx prettier --check Frontend/src Backend/src Backend/scripts .eslintrc.json .lintstagedrc package.json Frontend/package.json Backend/package.json Backend/tsconfig.json Backend/vitest.postgres.config.ts .github/workflows/ci.yml docs/testing-guide.md
scripts.ci:local: npm run ci:quality && npm run ci:frontend && npm run ci:backend && npm run ci:api:postgres
